import argparse
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


def sandbox_run(
    command: str,
    workspace: str | None = None,
    image: str = "debian:stable-slim",
    timeout: int = 60,
    network: str = "none",
    memory: str = "2g",
    pids: int = 512,
    cpus: float = 2.0,
) -> str:
    if shutil.which("podman") is None and shutil.which("docker") is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Neither podman nor docker is available on PATH")

    runtime = "podman" if shutil.which("podman") else "docker"

    argv = [
        runtime, "run", "--rm", "--pull=missing",
        f"--network={network}",
        f"--memory={memory}",
        f"--pids-limit={pids}",
        f"--cpus={cpus}",
        "--cap-drop=ALL",
        "--security-opt=no-new-privileges",
    ]

    if workspace is not None:
        argv.extend(["-v", f"{workspace}:/workspace:rw", "-w", "/workspace"])

    argv.append(image)
    argv.append("sh")
    argv.append("-c")
    argv.append(command)

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            argv,
            shell=False,
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        stdout = b""
        stderr = b"Command timed out"
        exit_code = 124
    else:
        stdout = result.stdout
        stderr = result.stderr
        exit_code = result.returncode

    MAX_BYTES = 50_000
    combined = stdout + stderr
    if len(combined) > MAX_BYTES:
        trunc_marker = "... [truncated]"
        if len(stdout) >= MAX_BYTES:
            stdout_part = stdout[:MAX_BYTES].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            stderr_part = ""
        else:
            stdout_part = stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            stderr_part = combined[len(stdout):MAX_BYTES].decode("utf-8", errors="replace") + trunc_marker
        return f"exit={exit_code}\n--- stdout ---\n{stdout_part}\n--- stderr ---\n{stderr_part}"

    stdout_decoded = stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    stderr_decoded = stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return f"exit={exit_code}\n--- stdout ---\n{stdout_decoded}\n--- stderr ---\n{stderr_decoded}"


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="sandbox.py")
    parser.add_argument("--image", default="debian:stable-slim")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--network", default="none")
    parser.add_argument("--memory", default="2g")
    parser.add_argument("--pids", type=int, default=512)
    parser.add_argument("--cpus", type=float, default=2.0)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace")
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not args.command:
        parser.error("COMMAND is required")

    if args.command[0] == "--":
        args.command = args.command[1:]

    command_str = " ".join(args.command)
    workspace = args.workspace if args.workspace is not None else os.getcwd()

    output = sandbox_run(
        command=command_str,
        workspace=workspace,
        image=args.image,
        timeout=args.timeout,
        network=args.network,
        memory=args.memory,
        pids=args.pids,
        cpus=args.cpus,
    )
    print(output)
    exit_code = 124 if "Command timed out" in output else int(output.split("\n")[0].split("=")[1])
    sys.exit(exit_code)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
